text:
That makes complete sense — that's a genuinely overwhelming amount of planning to absorb in one sitting, even just reading it. A cross-country move with a partner, a dog, and a 10-week clock is a lot.

Take a break. The checklist will still be here when you're ready to start working through it. If it helps, the most urgent things to tackle first are really just two or three: booking your movers or truck, confirming your Oregon housing, and getting the vet records together for your dog. Everything else flows from those.

Is there a specific piece you want to tackle next when you're feeling up to it, or did you still want that compact one-page moving day essentials list?
